description: Machine-readable definition cards for Kaalam's flagship Chitra-family ayanamsas. Numbers are Kaalam-owned statements of definition and measured residual budgets; production values still flow through Swiss Ephemeris as documented. Do not re-fit these to chase third-party software.
not_claimed: JHora bit-identity for Dhruva Chitra (novel frame)
that DPL and Dhruva produce the same sky at all epochs
upgrade_protocol: If Swiss Ephemeris, sefstars.txt, or Hipparcos inputs change such that frozen golden or independent-oracle tests fail: re-run derivation/oracle scripts, re-certify, and update cards deliberately. Never silently widen tolerances.

anchor.semantics: Spica geometric truepos longitude is pinned to 180 deg at every epoch

zero_epoch_property.note: Derived property of the live implementation, never a runtime input

DPL.frame_sigma_source: Same Hipparcos-2 Spica realization RSS budget as SRF (photocenter/zonal/PM); star-tracking does not remove catalog realization uncertainty
structural_defects_acknowledged: Frame rotates with Spica proper motion (~5.2 arcsec/century)
Displayed ayanamsa scalar carries instantaneous nutation (~+/-1.5 arcsec annual pure-nutation component under TRUEPOS)

Dhruva Chitra.ayanamsa_method_note: get_ayanamsa_ex_ut does not honor SIDBIT_ECL_T0 frozen reference (measured off by several to ~17 arcsec depending on epoch). Plain get_ayanamsa_ut is required.

anchor.star: Spica (alpha Virginis, HIP 65474) direction frozen at J2000.0
anchor.semantics: Frame-fixed: Spica drifts from 180 deg at its own PM after freeze (D8 signature)

Dhruva Chitra.vs_dpl_j2000_gap_cause: nutation-in-longitude Delta-psi at J2000.0 TT (~-13.93 arcsec); not a catalog discrepancy
